verdict.rationale: CT Corporation is a compliance and registered-agent service handling customer data, so customer-selectable storage region or data residency is a fair axis for this kind of product. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes that were blocked or redirected, with no content about data residency or region selection, so there is no evidence the capability exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
